text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: My schedule's been a little hectic lately… Maybe I replaced a few too many meals with Toughness bars.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: But they're so convenient and delicious… It's going to be a struggle to go without them for a while!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Oh! Maybe it'll be okay if I just go with a different flavor? Like, I could go for shrimp instead of chocolate…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: No, I've got to deal with all these pimples first! Ugh, there's no hiding these things!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ines Fujin seems to be quite worried about the condition of her skin.
